dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped structures on the mid-dorsal flank exhibit irregular, high-frequency serrated perimeters. These structures show a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity light pigment borders to darker, low-intensity interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is visible on the pectoral flipper and neck area, lacking internal gradients and forming a random distribution of stippled points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form a distinct scalene triangle, with the most anterior point situated closer to the dorsal midline relative to the two posterior points.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a continuous reticulated network where light-colored perimeters of adjacent polygons merge, creating a lace-like appearance across the lower posterior third of the visible body.
